name: Kitchen-smoked buffalo
summary: Buffalo dried over a fire. Vietnam News soaks it two hours and smokes it about 15 hours, until brown-red. Vietnamnet marinates it 2–3 hours, dries it slowly over charcoal, and often resteams it about 30 minutes. Whether this is nhứa giảng is Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Dien Bien Phu. Vietnam News, 28 Apr 2024, and Vietnamnet, 8 Oct 2015, describe buffalo. The culture desk’s nhứa giảng also names pork and beef and does not print these hours.
taste: Vietnam News says the finished meat is brown-red and aromatic of the mountains. Vietnamnet says the sweetness of the buffalo stays if it is taken off while just done, inside the seasoning.
howToEat: Vietnam News, quoting Hào Giàng Xén: free-range hill buffalo, firm meat, soaked with mắc khén, salt, lemongrass leaves, chilli, sugar, and garlic for two hours, then hung on bamboo skewers over a kitchen wood fire for about 15 hours.

Vietnamnet: trim the sinew and the silver skin, slice with the grain, marinate with lemongrass, ginger, garlic, chopped dried chilli, and crushed mắc khén for 2–3 hours, dry on skewers over charcoal far enough to cook slowly, and often resteam about 30 minutes.
The two hours, the 2–3 hours, the 15 hours, and the resteam all stay. A price is Check on arrival.
where: No street was printed. It is not filed as the Sơn La smoked meat. A stall hour is Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Kitchen-smoked buffalo in Dien Bien Phu
seoDescription: Buffalo smoked about 15 hours on Vietnam News, or 2–3 hours and a resteam on Vietnamnet. Not collapsed into nhứa giảng. A price is Check on arrival.
